recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: Zammad GmbH Zammad Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that can allow the local zammad user to escalate privileges to root. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102489.

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: Zammad GmbH Zammad Session Fixation Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains a session fixation vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution as the zammad user. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102490.

Fortinet FortiMail contains a path traversal and an improper neutralization of NULL byte or NULL character vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying system via crafted HTTP or HTTPS requests.

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Hex Encoding Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains a hex encoding vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to access an affected system with privileges of the admin user due to improper handling of URI encoding in an HTTP request.

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: Apple iOS, macOS, and iPadOS contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in CoreGraphics that may lead to arbitrary code execution.

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution or denial of service

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper input validation vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: Mikrotik RouterOS Improper Enforcement of Behavioral Workflow Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: Mikrotik RouterOS contains an improper enforcement of behavioral workflow vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated client to open a session channel and send an exec request. This vulnerability can be chained to achieve unauthenticated exploitation of CVE-2026-86060.
Microsoft SharePoint contains a code injection vulnerability which could allow an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: WordPress Core Remote File Inclusion Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: WordPress Core contains a remote file inclusion vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to make page-template resolution include a chosen readable local `.php` file outside the active theme directories, leading to remote code execution.

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: WSO2 Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: WSO2 API Control Plane, API Manager, Traffic Manager & Universal Gateway contain a path traversal vulnerability that could allow for unrestricted file upload and lead to remote code execution.

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Commerce and Magento Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: Adobe Commerce and Magento contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that could allow an attacker to leverage this vulnerability to gain elevated access to sensitive resources without any user interaction.

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator (VCO) on-prem contains an improper input validation vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: F5 BIG-IP APM Heap-based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: F5 BIG-IP APM contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability when access policy and an OAuth profile are configured on a virtual server. This vulnerability could allow an unauthenticated attacker to perform remote code execution.

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: Check Point Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: Check Point Security Management Server, Multi-Domain Security Management Server, Log Server, Multi-Domain Log Server, and SmartEvent contain a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to upload and execute arbitrary scripts.
